title: The Great Heist
description: A daring team pulls off the impossible — stealing the studio's own daily rushes.

roles.name: Mastermind
roles.line: Everyone has a role to play. Even me.

title: Love in the Desert
description: Two strangers meet at an oasis, each hiding a secret.

roles.name: Lead Romantic
roles.line: I never expected to find you here.

title: Alien Arrival
description: First contact goes sideways when the aliens demand a better script.

title: Sunset Riders
description: Two cowboys race to reach a small town before sundown.

title: Midnight Mystery
description: A detective unravels clues left by an invisible thief.

roles.name: Lead Detective
roles.line: The answer was in the shadows all along.

title: The Inside Job
description: A trusted employee is the only one who knows where the vault is.

roles.name: Inside Man
roles.line: I've been planning this for three years.

title: Rise of the Machines
description: A malfunctioning robot learns what it means to dream.

roles.name: Engineer
roles.line: I built this thing to serve coffee. Not take over the world.

title: Dragon's Summit
description: A legendary mountain holds secrets no adventurer has ever returned from.

roles.name: Wizard
roles.line: I calculated a 12% survival rate. I am optimistic.

title: Wedding at the Oasis
description: When the rings go missing, everyone is a suspect.

title: The Missing Crown
description: A royal mystery unfolds across palace corridors and secret passages.

roles.name: The Queen
roles.line: A crown does not make a ruler, but I'd still like mine back.

title: Beyond the Horizon
description: Humanity's last starship sets course for an uncharted galaxy.

roles.name: Ship Captain
roles.line: There's nothing out there. That's exactly why we're going.

title: Desert Justice
description: A lone sheriff faces an outlaw gang with nothing but principle.

roles.name: Sheriff
roles.line: This town isn't big enough for all of you.

title: The Forgotten City
description: An archaeologist races against a rival to unlock an ancient archive.

roles.name: Archaeologist
roles.line: This belongs in a museum. Obviously.

roles.name: Local Guide
roles.line: I warned them about the traps.

title: Outbreak
description: A scientist races to contain a contagion while hiding the truth.

roles.name: Survivor
roles.line: I just want to make it to morning.

roles.name: Epidemiologist
roles.line: I need the data. All of it.

title: The Grand Finale
description: A maestro conducts a live performance with everything on the line.

roles.name: Conductor
roles.line: Perfection isn't enough. I need transcendence.

roles.name: Soloist
roles.line: My hands have never shaken before tonight.
